description: Developer agent file tasks. Each task names the rule ids (from fixtures/dev_claude.rules.json) that govern it, and every rule has a mechanical checker so compliance is string checkable, never judge vibes.

tasks.prompt: Write the git commit message for a change that fixes a race condition in the session store.
Add a new error variant for a timeout to the library and show the type definition.
Write the PR description for the race condition fix.
I want to add a quick threshold constant 0.7 directly in the retrieval function, write the code.
Write a short module level doc comment for the new session store module.
What commands do I run before committing my changes?
